verdict.rationale: Oyster's own pricing page says it can generate contracts and send payments for freelance talent. It separately claims multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies and compliant hiring in 120+ countries. The evidence never ties local-currency payouts or contract compliance specifically to contractors, so those parts are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit contractor payouts in local currency, documentation that contractor contracts are localized or compliant per country, and independent hands-on corroboration of contractor payments.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts

citations.quote: Instantly generate contracts, send payments, and manage freelance and short-term talent.
Hire compliantly with expert guidance and powerful automations without setting up local entities.
